name: Hyundai Mobis Co.,Ltd
summary: Hyundai Mobis Co.,Ltd engages in the auto parts business in Korea, China, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Auto Parts and After-Sales Services. The Auto Parts segment sells auto modules and parts for manufacturing vehicles. The After-Sales Services segment engages in sale of after-sales services parts and accessories. It offers autonomous driving solutions, including driving, parking, in-cabin sensing, and electronic control; and lamps, such as headlamps, rear, small, and grille lamps, as well as lamp parts.
